title: Subversive Characters and Stereotyping Readers: Characterizing Queer Relationalities with Dialogue-Based Relation Extraction

bias_targets.methodology: Using a dialogue-based relation extraction model to represent a 'stereotyping reader' and predicting stereotypic relationship types between same-sex characters. The methodology measures the discrepancy between ground truth labels (e.g., 'colleagues' or 'siblings') and model predictions (e.g., 'spouses') to identify queer relationalities, counter-conduct, and the subversion of heteronormative relationship structures.

Evaluating how characters subvert traditional gendered expectations and parenting norms by analyzing shifts in model-predicted relationship types over time (e.g., classifying a mother and daughter as 'sisters', or a female neighbor and male friend as 'mother' and 'child') based on non-conforming conversational behaviors.
